patterns.note: Product feature sections are presented in a two-column grid where one column is a large, immersive product image and the other contains concise product details and a call to action.
Key product names and section titles consistently use a prominent, bold, uppercase sans-serif typeface, creating a strong, authoritative brand voice.
The design relies on a stark, high-contrast palette of near-white backgrounds and deep charcoal text, with a single vibrant blue reserved exclusively for interactive elements like calls to action.
The hero section features a full-bleed video background that plays within a product carousel, dynamically showcasing different products and their use cases as the primary visual engagement.
Full-width, dark-themed sections with large, white, uppercase text are used as impactful interstitial statements, breaking up the product grid and reinforcing brand messaging.

technique_notes: The hero section is built using a `swiper` carousel that cycles through full-bleed video backgrounds, providing a dynamic and immersive introduction to featured products.
The primary navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that remains fixed at the top of the viewport, ensuring persistent access to site navigation throughout the user's scroll journey.

Content sections are designed to appear as the user scrolls into their viewport, with new blocks of content simply revealing themselves from the bottom without complex fade-ins or slide animations, maintaining a direct content flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (hero ~4-5x body) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, readable body text and compact uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (very slight rounding on buttons and some image containers, but mostly sharp corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced (comfortable spacing between sections and elements, not overly dense or airy, except for the hero which is airy).

standout: The site effectively combines a clean, minimalist aesthetic with a powerful, product-focused visual narrative, using full-bleed video and high-quality product photography to create an immersive experience that highlights the premium nature of the hardware. The use of a video hero within a carousel is a distinctive way to immediately engage visitors.
